4. The said Tarini Chandra granted settlement of 3.72 acres of land of various plots of khatian Nos. 41 and 42 to one Ruhini Lal Das by a registered kabuliyat dated 3-9-42. The said Tarini Chandra granted settlement of 4.51 acres of land of khatian No. 41 to one Durga Chandra Das and Shyama Chandra Das by a registered kabuliat dated 2-10-42. Thereafter Durga Chandra died leaving behind plaintiff No.3 and Shyama Charan died leaving behind plaintiff Nos.1 and 2 who had been possessing the same. The said Tarini Chandra granted rayati settlement of 2.43 acres of khatian No. 41 to one Bharat Chandra Das by a registered kabuliat dated 1-4-43 and delivered possession. Thereafter the said Tarini Chandra granted settlement of 1.46½ acres of land of khatian No. 41 to Mohini and Jagat, brothers of Bharat Chandra. The said Mohini Chandra died childless leaving behind her brothers, Jagat Chandra and Bharat Chandra who became the owners of his property. Jagat Chandra died leaving his only daughter Haribala and Bharat Chandra died leaving his only daughter Hemlata who became the owners in possession of the property left by their respective father. The aforesaid Tarini Chandra out of Schedule I land granted settlement of 0.65 acres of plot No. 16 and 32½ acres of plot No. 481 to Copal Chandra Das and also 0.77 acres of plot No. 464 to Abhoy Chandra Das on the basis of kabuliat. Thus Tarini Chandra ceased to have any interest in Schedule I land. 

 21. The learned Advocate for the plaintiff-petitioners next argued that after the auction purchase by the landlord the predecessor of the defendants took settlement of 2.43 acres of land from the auction purchaser landlord. But no kabuliyat or patta has been filed in support of their contention. It is to be stated here that the defendants denied to have taken any settlement of the suit land from the landlord Chandi Charan after alleged auction purchase. Rather their definite case is that they continued in prossession of the suit land from the time of their predecessor-in-interest Nida Gazi in korfa right.
